_comment: Curriculum mapping for Clinical Skills Lab scenarios. Maps each scenario step to NATCEP domain, criticality, and curriculum module/topic. Used for result summaries and remediation targeting.

standards_reference.regulatory_body: Texas Health and Human Services Commission (HHSC)
standards_reference.competency_model: NATCEP Nurse Aide Training and Competency Evaluation Program

natcep_domains.name: Infection Control
natcep_domains.description: Standard precautions, hand hygiene, PPE use and disposal, isolation procedures

natcep_domains.name: Safety and Emergency
natcep_domains.description: Fall prevention, safe transfers, body mechanics, emergency response, restraint alternatives

natcep_domains.name: Basic Nursing Skills
natcep_domains.description: Vital signs, positioning, range of motion, personal hygiene, feeding, elimination

natcep_domains.name: Communication and Documentation
natcep_domains.description: Verbal/nonverbal communication, documentation, reporting, medical terminology

natcep_domains.name: Professionalism and Role
natcep_domains.description: Scope of practice, ethics, resident rights, professional conduct, teamwork

natcep_domains.name: Restorative Care
natcep_domains.description: Mobility assistance, ADL support, assistive devices, independence promotion

criticality_levels.CRITICAL: Failure of this step results in automatic skill failure on Prometric/Pearson exams. Represents direct patient safety risk.
criticality_levels.MAJOR: Significant deduction. Does not trigger automatic failure but indicates serious gap in competency.
criticality_levels.MINOR: Small deduction. Technique or communication issue with limited safety impact.

step_01.title: Identify need for hand hygiene
step_01.exam_notes: Failure to perform hand hygiene at the start of ANY skill = automatic skill failure on Prometric exam.

step_02.title: Proper hand hygiene technique
step_02.exam_notes: Must scrub all surfaces for minimum 20 seconds. Turn off faucet with paper towel.

step_03.title: Select and don PPE in correct order
step_03.exam_notes: CDC donning order: gown → mask → eye protection → gloves. Gloves must overlap gown cuffs.

step_04.title: Doff PPE safely
step_04.exam_notes: Doffing order: gloves → gown → mask. Each item removed without contaminating face or clothing.

step_05.title: Hand hygiene after PPE removal
step_05.exam_notes: Hand hygiene after PPE removal is mandatory. Examiner verifies this step explicitly.

step_01.title: Prepare environment
step_01.curriculum_topic: Safe Transfer Preparation and Environment Setup
step_01.exam_notes: Wheelchair must be locked at 45° angle before the resident moves. Missing this step = major deduction.

step_02.title: Apply gait belt correctly
step_02.exam_notes: Gait belt applied over clothing, snug with two-finger check, buckle not on spine. Required for transfer skills.

step_03.title: Verify wheelchair locks and footrests
step_03.exam_notes: Both wheels locked and footrests cleared before initiating stand. Examiner verifies verbally and observationally.

step_04.title: Correct body mechanics during transfer
step_04.curriculum_topic: Body Mechanics for Safe Patient Handling
step_04.exam_notes: Examiner observes for proper body mechanics throughout the transfer. Twisting or bending at waist noted as deduction.

step_05.title: Post-transfer positioning and safety
step_05.exam_notes: Footrests replaced, feet positioned, gait belt removed, comfort checked, hand hygiene performed.

step_01.title: Prepare and identify resident
step_01.exam_notes: Two-identifier verification required before any resident care. Hand hygiene also required first.

step_02.title: Oral temperature technique
step_02.exam_notes: Sublingual placement, probe cover required, wait for device signal. Normal oral range 97–99°F.

step_03.title: Radial pulse technique
step_03.exam_notes: Index and middle fingers (not thumb), radial artery, 60-second count. Normal 60–100 bpm.

step_04.title: Respiration count
step_04.exam_notes: Count without informing resident, 60 seconds (rise + fall = 1 breath). Normal 12–20/min.

step_05.title: Manual blood pressure technique
step_05.curriculum_topic: Blood Pressure Measurement – Manual Auscultatory Method
step_05.exam_notes: Cuff 1-2 inches above antecubital, arm at heart level, slow deflation, both systolic and diastolic recorded. Normal <120/80.

step_06.title: Recognize normals and report abnormals
step_06.curriculum_topic: Reporting Abnormal Findings to Licensed Nurse
step_06.exam_notes: CNA must report abnormal findings to the licensed nurse promptly. Scope of practice — no independent clinical decisions.

step_07.title: Accurate documentation
step_07.exam_notes: All four values, units, date/time, signature, and notation of reporting required. Timely and complete.
